{{Quote|There are two ways to destroy a person, Jorj. Kill him, or ruin his reputation.''"<br />"''I suppose that makes sense. Any idea which approach Nuso Esva's planning?''"<br />"''If I know Nuso Esva, very likely both.|Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo and his friend Jorj Car'das before the battle in the Poln system|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] '''Nuso Esva''' was a [[Storm-hair]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who emerged from an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|planet]] alongside a group of [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]]. After emerging, Esva built a [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]] in the Unknown Regions. Using a massive [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]], the Storm-hair launched a [[Nuso Esva's conquests|series of conquests]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], Esva's nemesis and an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], began [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|opposing]] the warlord, pushing him back. In response, the Storm-hair designed a plot to destroy the Chiss in an attempt to destroy him. With the goal of drawing Thrawn to the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], Esva had his Chosen kidnap the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. The warlord forced Ferrouz to ally himself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that opposed the empire Thrawn served and [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the Chosen to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Ferrouz, an event that would bring the warlord's Chiss nemesis to the Poln system.

Esva infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], assuming the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] dignitary "[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Odo'''." The warlord brought the ''Chimaera'' to the Unknown Regions [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]], where the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and Thrawn's [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] [[Engagement at Teptixii|fought]] [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|one]] of Esva's attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. The squadron fled the engagement after the ''Chimaera'' began to divide it under the Storm-hair's directive, and Esva had Thrawn's second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], tell his superior that he was to travel to the Poln system in response to an [[Battle for Poln Major|insurrection]]. The senior captain, traveling aboard his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Lost Reef]]'', followed his [[Task force/Legends|task force]] and the ''Chimaera'' to Poln. Esva sabotaged the latter [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and set the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] on a collision course with a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. He summoned his [[Eastern Fleet]] and commanded it to [[Battle of the Poln system|destroy]] any ship that attempted to assist the ''Chimaera''.

However, Thrawn moved the ''Chimaera'' away from its collision course with his freighter's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. The Chiss summoned the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet, which shattered Esva's forces. Esva fled the [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] aboard his freighter, the ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Esva's conquests had been brought to an end by Thrawn's [[Empire of the Hand]] forces from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The Storm-hair was hiding on the Unknown Regions planet [[Quethold]], allying himself with the world's ruler, the [[Quesoth]] [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]]. After Thrawn sent his forces to Quethold in an attempt to destroy Esva, the warlord's troops&mdash;including [[Quesoth Soldier]]s and thirty Chosen warriors&mdash;attempted to [[Attack on the Red City|commandeer]] the Imperial vehicles that brought the Imperial forces to Quethold. During the ensuing battle, Thrawn manipulated a [[Speaker/Legends|speaker]] that transmitted the Queen of the Red's orders to the Quesoth forces and commanded the Soldiers to rush at Esva. The warlord feared that the Quesoth monarch was a [[Treason/Legends|traitor]], killing her, and prompting her troops to kill him in retaliation.

==Biography==
===Emergence===
{{Quote|Warlord Nuso Esva has become one of those threats. He possesses an unusually strong spacegoing navy, along with many slave and tributary worlds stretching into Wild Space and to the edge of the Empire. I believe he is even now planning to extend his influence into Imperial space.''"<br />"''An alien, I presume. Can he be bought?''"<br />"''Not bought, bargained with, or allied with. I've sent several communiqués to him suggesting each of those options. He's turned down all of them.|Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] Nuso Esva was a [[Storm-hair]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who emerged from an unidentified [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] alongside his Storm-hair [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Using a massive [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]] consisting of three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of equal strength, one of which was the [[Eastern Fleet]], and the Chosen, Esva [[Nuso Esva's conquests|conquered]] several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the Unknown Regions and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], which formed the warlord's [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="War">''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' establishes that Nuso Esva's [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|conflict]] with [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] lasted ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. As ''Crisis of Faith'' takes place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the conflict must have begun in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the Storm-hair warlord began to [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|fight]] the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn,"<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The senior captain sent several communiqués and treaties to the warlord that suggested an alliance and a bargain; however, the latter turned them down, forcing Thrawn to oppose Esva. The senior captain's forces were unable to defeat the Storm-hair's forces, and the Chiss asked [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to give him six [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that would allow him to deal a crushing blow to Esva; however, the emperor refused.<ref name="Choices of One" />

===The choices of one===
====Promises of glory====
{{Quote|As he said: everything. Tell me, Commander. Have you ever heard the saying 'The choices of one shape the futures of all'?''"<br />"''Yes, I believe so. Jedi, isn't it?''"<br />"''The Jedi may have stolen it, but it was originally from the ''Song of Salaban''. The point is that each person's decisions affect everyone around him. Friends, family, business associates&mdash;even total strangers. You ask what happened to Sorro? That's what happened. He made bad decisions&mdash;many of them. In the process, he lost everything he held of value.|Warlord Nuso Esva, posing as Lord Odo, and Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
Under Esva's directive, the Chosen traveled to the Imperial [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]&mdash;consisting of the planets [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]]. There, they kidnapped the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]], and gave him a note written by Esva. The note commanded Ferrouz to offer a base and supplies to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that opposed Palpatine's Empire in an attempt to draw an Imperial presence and Thrawn to the Poln system. The Storm-hair also made a promise to the Rebel [[Vestin Axlon]]: he promised that when his forces destroyed the Empire, avenging Axlon's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which the Empire had [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]], Esva's battle fleet would join the Alliance and assist them in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the Empire. Axlon believed Esva's promise to be genuine, and he helped the Chosen in their efforts on Poln Major.<ref name="Choices of One" />

[[File:Chimaera-TCGIE.png|thumb|left|300px|Nuso Esva infiltrated the ''Chimaera'' (pictured).]]
Esva's agents kidnapped the [[Sorro's family|family]] of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] known as "[[Sorro]]" and forced the Human to serve as Esva's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the warlord's [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'' to redeem his family. The [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] rendezvoused with the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], whose [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Calo Drusan]] had verified Esva's credentials after the warlord promised him a victory over the Rebellion that would make Drusan an admiral. Once the Kazellis [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the ''Chimaera'', six starships of Esva's realm [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|attacked]] the ''Salaban's Hope''. Esva, who assumed the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] dignitary "[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo," instructed Drusan to pull the two endmost attackers toward the ''Chimaera'' with the Star Destroyer's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] and destroy them. While Drusan did as the warlord instructed, the ''Salaban's Hope'' helped destroy the other marauders. After two of the attackers fled and the rest were destroyed by Esva and the Imperial vessel, the warlord's freighter was brought aboard the ''Chimaera''. To conceal his [[Alien/Legends|alien]] identity, Esva donned a mask and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] before leaving the ''Salaban's Hope''. The Star Destroyer's [[third bridge officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], greeted the warlord before the Storm-hair was brought to his new [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

Shortly afterward, Esva requested new quarters closer to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] from which he could monitor the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] every system. While Sorro had [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]], Pellaeon attempted to interrogate him but was stopped by Esva. The warlord requested Pellaeon's help to move his belongings to his new quarters. While on their way to the Storm-hair's new residence, the warlord told the commander that Sorro had made the wrong choices and lost his family in the process; he explained that that was the reason for the pilot's deep sadness, citing an excerpt of the ''[[Song of Salaban]]'', an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] legend. After the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} crew prepared his quarters, Esva made a brief visit to an [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva's commanders)|unknown]] world where he and his commanders planned Thrawn's destruction. He also visited the<ref name="Choices of One" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC-W">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]]</ref> planet [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]], where he acquired [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and cylindrical equipment that he planned to use to sabotage the ''Chimaera''. After returning to the Star Destroyer, the Storm-hair brought his equipment to his quarters.<ref name="Choices of One" />

====Storm-hair versus Storm-hair====
{{Dialogue|Warlord Nuso Esva|The larger ships, the Firekilns, are more powerful than you realize. Laser to laser, five of them are an even match for his Star Destroyer, and Nuso Esva currently has eight of them in place. Those are his ships, at any rate. Captain Parck would know better whether or not the warlord himself is on the scene. The point is that while the Firekilns are heavily armed, their shields are inferior to those of the Imperials. They rely on the screening ships to block the ''Admonitor''{{'s}} attacks.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon|Except that the screening ships aren't just running defense, but are also armed. If they can take down the cruisers while the ''Admonitor'' is picking at them, he'll be left all alone.|Captain Calo Drusan|Not while we're here he won't. Let's see if Nuso Esva has the stomach for a fight when he hasn't got the odds on his side. Helm, increase to flank and take us across the edge of the enemy formation.|Warlord Nuso Esva|Not to the edge. Angle thirty degrees to portside and set our vector to cut behind the formation.|attr=Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo, Commander Gilad Pellaeon, and Captain Calo Drusan|src=<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:VossParck.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Captain Voss Parck engaged Esva's forces at Teptixii.]]
After arriving on the bridge, Esva instructed Drusan to travel to the Unknown Regions, where the ''Chimaera'' would attack one of the Storm-hair warlord's [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]]. The Star Destroyer then arrived in the middle of a [[Engagement at Teptixii|battle]] in the<ref name="Choices of One" /> [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]</ref> between Esva's attack squadron and Thrawn's [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']], whose [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was the Star Destroyer ''[[Admonitor]]''. Esva instructed Drusan and Pellaeon to divide his attack squadron's [[Firekiln]] warships and their [[Unidentified escort ship|escorts]] by moving the ''Chimaera'' behind the squadron's formation, which would prompt its components to flee. As the Storm-hair force was attempting to capture Task Force Admonitor's two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and four [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]], Esva ordered Drusan to angle his Star Destroyer thirty degrees to portside and begin dividing the attack squadron, which then fled.<ref name="Choices of One" />

After his forces' retreat, Esva told [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], Thrawn's second-in-command, that Thrawn was to travel to the Poln system as a response to a possible insurrection; however, the captain had received no communications regarding the insurrection and refused. Soon after, however, the ''Admonitor'' received a message from Imperial General [[Kauf Ularno]] of the Poln system invoking [[Directive Four-Seventeen]], requesting all nearby forces of the Galactic Empire to assist the system after the Chosen attempted to murder Ferrouz. Ularno broadcast a message that established that Rebel involvement in the assassination attempt was suspected as suggested by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who knew that if no broadcast was made, Esva would be suspicious. Task Force ''Admonitor'' and the ''Chimaera'' then left for Poln.<ref name="Choices of One" />

====Ballet and broken promises====
{{Quote|Not yet. But if Warlord Nuso Esva has his way, you soon will.''"<br />"''Why is that?''"<br />"''Because the Troukree are Nuso Esva's stealth weapon of choice. Expert saboteurs, dangerous warriors, cunning and deceitful beyond measure.''"<br />"''Sounds like they'll be worth keeping an eye on when they surface. What does this have to do with you and Sorro?''"<br />"''I believe the Troukree may have infiltrated the ''Chimaera''.|Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo, and Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:ThermalDetonator-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|300px|Nuso Esva used thermal detonators to sabotage the ''Chimaera''.]]
Following Thrawn's task force and the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} arrival over Poln Major, Esva and Sorro organized a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ballet performance with a dozen [[MSE-9 General Purpose Droid|MSE-9 droids]] in the Star Destroyer's main [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room. Pellaeon arrived while searching for Esva and demanded an explanation, which the Storm-hair provided. According to Esva, his [[Troukree]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]], who were actually Thrawn's agents and not Esva's, had infiltrated the ''Chimaera''. The warlord claimed the ballet and an [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[Mark Two seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] he hid in his clothing were locating the Troukree.<ref name="Choices of One" />

In reality, the seeker was just one of several droids traveling through the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} ventilation systems en route to the engine room. Pellaeon apologized for the interruption and left. With the seekers and his thermal detonators, Esva prepared to destroy the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} engines. Shortly after, on the bridge, Drusan told Pellaeon to find Esva, who was not present as expected. However, the commander was unable to locate the warlord. Esva killed Drusan while his Eastern Fleet arrived in the Poln system and prepared to destroy the ''Admonitor'' and the ''Chimaera'', moving to prevent any ship from assisting the latter Star Destroyer. The Storm-hair then destroyed the engines of both ships.<ref name="Choices of One" />

Esva attempted to incapacitate the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} crew by spreading the nonfatal [[vertigon gas]] through the ventilation systems. He set the ''Chimaera'' on a collision course with a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and destroyed the Star Destroyer's helm station, preventing the vessel from moving. When Pellaeon arrived on the bridge, he learned of Esva's promise to Drusan from the dying captain and learned the warlord's true identity from Thrawn, who spoke with the commander over comm.<ref name="Choices of One" />

====A fiery collision====
{{Quote|But first, your soldiers and subordinates are going to watch as you make your final, fatal choice.''"<br />"''What choice is that?''"<br />"''In fourteen minutes, unless something is done, the ''Chimaera'' and the Golan will destroy each other in a fiery collision. The other ships of your task force are helpless to interfere. I have all of them trapped here by Poln Minor, and should any of them attempt to leave their current positions my Firekilns have been ordered to intercept and destroy. The only way to prevent the collision is for either the ''Chimaera'' or the Golan to open fire and destroy the other. You, Captain Thrawn, will make that decision. You will decide which of your Empire's precious war machines you will order destroyed. You will decide which of your Emperor's warriors will die.|Warlord Nuso Esva and Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
Sorro, who was wearing Esva's mask and clothing, rushed at Pellaeon on the bridge and was subsequently killed. Following this, Commander Thrawn and Esva engaged in a conversation via comm regarding the latter's sabotage of the ''Chimaera'' after the warlord left the Star Destroyer aboard his Kazellis freighter. The Storm-hair mocked Sorro and presented Thrawn with a difficult choice that would ruin his reputation and result in his destruction: the ''Chimaera'' was on a collision course with the Golan, and the Star Destroyer was unable to move. Task Force ''Admonitor'' was trapped with Poln Minor's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] well, and the Firekilns of the Eastern Fleet were prepared to destroy any ship that attempted to assist the ''Chimaera''. If Thrawn failed to choose between the Star Destroyer or the defense platform, both war machines and all aboard would die in a "[[Fire/Legends|fiery]] collision." However, if he chose the ''Chimaera'', the Golan would be destroyed, damaging the Chiss's reputation.<ref name="Choices of One" />

[[File:Executor_09_crop.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The ''Executor'' was one of the warships that shattered Nuso Esva's Eastern Fleet.]]
The warlord was confident that Thrawn had been defeated; however, the senior captain's [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]'' used its tractor beams to move the ''Chimaera'' away from the Golan. Shortly after, a force of [[Whisperlike fighter]]s&mdash;which had been armed with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s by Chosen commander [[Ranquiv]] on Poln Minor&mdash;attempted to destroy the ''Admonitor'', but the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] were destroyed by the Golan. As Esva boasted and explained in detail how he would destroy the Poln system, Thrawn focused on amplifying his transmission with the warlord, which reached the Quesoth<ref name="Choices of One" /> homeworld of [[Quethold]] and the [[Stromma]] homeworld of [[Oristrom]],<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> both of which were located in the Unknown Regions and both of which housed two of the Storm-hair's allies.<ref name="Choices of One" />

Esva vowed to destroy the Poln system with his Firekilns, but the Chiss suggested that the system's inhabitants could become his allies. The Storm-hair dismissed the suggestion, revealing that his only allies were the Chosen and that everyone else was merely a tool. Esva then announced that his fleet was in position and that his nemesis's [[Time/Legends|time]] was ended. Thrawn responded by summoning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet, including the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and several Imperial Star Destroyers. Aboard the ''Lost Reef'', the freighter's pilot, [[Jorj Car'das]], told Thrawn that he could destroy Esva's Kazellis and kill the warlord; however, the senior captain commanded him to focus on the main battle. Esva was caught off guard by Thrawn's reinforcements, which the warlord had not prepared for, and his Eastern Fleet was defeated by the Imperial forces while Esva fled aboard the ''Salaban's Hope''.<ref name="Choices of One" />

===Lost glory===
====A queen's rise; a warlord's fall====
{{Quote|The old ways are at an end, Trevik of the Midli of the Seventh of the Red. Why should I accept death for myself and my city merely because the Queen of the White has arisen?''"<br />"''You're a näive fool. A Queen-a true Queen-doesn't simply sit back and accept the way of the world. A true Queen grasps the world by the throat and squeezes her own destiny from it. Understand?|The Queen of the Red and Warlord Nuso Esva, to bowlcarrier Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
After his campaign against Thrawn, Esva launched his [[Braccio campaign]], which nearly destroyed six species. On Oristrom, the warlord's forces [[Battle of Oristrom|fought]] the Stromma, who had the upper hand in the battle until Esva assumed personal command of his forces. However, Thrawn, who had become a [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]], arrived and forced the Storm-hair's forces to retreat.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Eight years later, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CD" /> the Grand Admiral forced Esva&mdash;whose battle fleet the Empire of the Hand reduced to remnants&mdash;and thirty of his most loyal Chosen warriors to retreat to Quethold.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

The warlord formed an alliance with the Quesoth ruler, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]]. He promised that if they captured Empire of the Hand juggernaut vehicles, he would siege Quethold's [[White City]] and assassinate the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Queen of the White]]. Killing the latter [[Queen/Legends|queen]] would make the Queen of the Red's reign eternal. Esva's siege of the White City would give him access to the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] beneath the settlement, where he planned to build a new fleet of fighter aircraft to fight his enemies. The Queen of the Red granted the warlord and his warriors quarters in the [[Dwelling of Guests]], a building in her [[Red City]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

[[File:Thrawn-TCGboxart.png|thumb|left|300px|Grand Admiral Thrawn, Nuso Esva's nemesis, fought the warlord for years, finally defeating him on Quethold.]]
A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after his arrival on Quethold, in the Dwelling of Guests, Esva and his Quesoth ally discussed the destruction of Thrawn and his ''Admonitor'', which was [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] Quethold after learning that the warlord was hiding on the planet. Aboard the ''Admonitor'', [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], the Queen of the Red's servant and confidant, met with Thrawn and his top commanders. The Grand Admiral sought to study the [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] Esva had brought to Quethold and tasked Nyama with planting a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] on a member of the Red monarch's entourage. Unbeknownst to the Chiss, Esva had prepared for this, bringing paintings that would lead Thrawn to reach the wrong conclusions about the warlord's strategy to his quarters. The Queen of the Red's [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]], who carried a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the ruler of the Quesoth, recorded Esva's art and Nyama shared the recordings with Thrawn, actions Esva predicted.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Knowing that Thrawn was going to attack the Red City, Esva had his Chosen set up defensive [[Stromma cannon|cannons]] and protected them and the Red Ciity with [[Planetary shield/Legends|umbrella shields]]. Under the warlord's directive, the Queen of the Red arrayed her [[Quesoth Soldier]]s at the western edge of the Red City's [[Setting Sun Avenue]], from which Thrawn decided to launch his attack based on his study of Esva's paintings. She also hid thousands of Soldiers in her city's homes, preparing an ambush on the Imperial forces. Once the Empire of the Hand's forces, which consisted of [[Tank/Legends|heavy juggernaut]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], [[Transport/Legends|transports]], and a squadron of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were deployed, and a group of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] flew over the Red City, the Chosen's cannons fired at the newcomers at Esva's command. Meanwhile, the Chosen and the Quesoth attempted to commandeer the juggernauts.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

====A bitter last stand====
{{Quote|You're going to take a message to Thrawn for me. Tell Thrawn that he may think he's won. But with my death, his own will not be far off. My followers are still out there, and they're more numerous than he can possibly imagine. No matter where he goes, no matter where he tries to hide, they will find him. You'll tell him that.|Warlord Nuso Esva tasks bowlcarrier Trevik with delivering a message to Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:Juggernautyavin.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Nuso Esva was determined to capture any vehicles after discovering that the Imperial juggernauts (one such vehicle pictured) were of no use to him.]]
Esva's forces soon discovered that the tanks carried no [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], rendering them useless to the warlord. While the Storm-hair commanded the Quesoth troops to travel to the Imperial transports and seize them instead, the TIEs destroyed most of the [[Speaker/Legends|speakers]] that transmitted the Queen of the Red's commands to her Soldiers, sparing one. The speakers' destruction prevented the Soldiers from moving to the transports, and Esva ordered the Red monarch to travel to the juggernauts and give her troops their new target. However, the queen refused to comply.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

The last speaker was commandeered by the Imperials, who used it to command the Soldiers to surround and protect Esva. As the Quesoth troops rushed at Esva, the warlord asked his Quesoth ally what she had told them to do, fearing she was a [[Treason/Legends|traitor]]. The queen claimed that she had not given any orders.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In response, Esva shot the Queen of the Red and most of her entourage with a weapon, sparing Trevik. By killing the Quesoth ruler, Esva had sealed his fate as the Soldiers would avenge their queen by killing the Storm-hair. Knowing that his death was imminent, Esva tasked Trevik with telling Thrawn that no matter where he hid, the Chosen would find and kill him. After Trevik left to fulfill his mission, Esva was killed by the Quesoth, and the Imperial forces killed his Chosen. After the battle, Thrawn's ''Admonitor'' traveled to the [[Chaos Triangle]], where it would clean up what the Chiss referred to as Esva's "legacy."<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Personality and traits==
===A military mind===
{{Quote|Allies? You have allies, Thrawn. All to me except the Chosen are mere tools. They can be useful tools, or they can be broken tools.''"<br />"''Interesting. I imagine the Stomma ''[sic]'' and Quesoth leadership will be interested to learn what their true positions will be should they choose to join your realm.''"<br />"''Your cleverness is wasted. Once we've dealt with you, my fleet will travel to the Stomma homeworld and I will once again make them useful tools. Your time is ended, Thrawn. My ships are now in their places.|Warlord Nuso Esva and Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:ChosenNusoEsva.png|thumb|left|300px|Warlord Nuso Esva's Chosen fought with fanatical zeal.]]
As a Storm-hair, Esva had [[Hair/Legends|hair]] the [[Color/Legends|color]] of a black storm [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]], shimmering, multicolored skin,<ref name="Choices of One" /> and two multifaceted yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> As the Storm-hair cited a line from the ''Song of Salaban'' to Pellaeon, the commander believed Esva was an Arkanian as the warlord's height and mass were within the Arkanian species' range. The Storm-hair's voice was melodious. While operating under the pseudonym of Lord Odo, Warlord Esva was calm, considered competent by Pellaeon, and helpful aboard the ''Chimaera'', offering tactical insight to Drusan and Parck during the engagement at Teptixii.<ref name="Choices of One" />

The warlord was stubborn and did not consider anyone but the Chosen his allies, treating those he used in his conquests as tools that merely did his bidding. If the warlord considered those tools useless or broken, Esva would force them to be useful. The Queen of the Red saw the warlord as an equal, not demanding a death-pledge from the Storm-hair as mandated by Quesoth custom. Esva believed that a true queen did not sit back and accept the way of the world, instead believing that a true queen "grasped the world by the throat and squeezed her destiny from it." Before Esva murdered the Quesoth ruler, the Queen of the Red commented that Esva sought to capture the Imperial transports and use them to flee Quethold, a comment that the warlord considered "foolish prattle." As the battle on Quethold came to a close, Esva grew furious and his voice was barely within the limits of civility while he spoke with the Queen of the Red.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

===One goal: victory===
{{Quote|You read the reports, LaRone&mdash;you saw how Nuso Esva operates. Kidnapping children, suborning Imperial officers, threatening to slag entire planets. The guy has to be stopped.|The Hand of Judgment's [[Joak Quiller]] to the group's leader, [[Daric LaRone]]|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:Daric_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Hand of Judgment (pictured) joined the Empire of the Hand because they believed that Warlord Nuso Esva had to be stopped.]]
To accomplish his goals, Esva kidnapped [[Youngling/Legends|children]], suborned Imperial officials, and threatened to shatter planets. His methods prompted the [[Hand of Judgment]], a group of five Imperial stormtrooper [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]] that helped the Empire free Ferrouz's family, to join Thrawn's Empire of the Hand and help turn his Troukree agents into Imperial stormtroopers so that they could use their maximum potential in their battles against Esva.<ref name="Choices of One" />

The Troukree agent [[Vaantaar]] saw that Esva sent a "dark challenge" before his attacks, and did not wish to see the warlord's legacy of destruction,<ref name="Choices of One" /> which he created after he was forced to retreat. Esva conquered more than twenty species that suffered under his reign of "terror." The Chosen were loyal to the warlord&mdash;who was also loyal to his warriors&mdash;fighting with fanatical zeal for the warlord and following the Storm-hair's scorched-ground policy, destroying everything they could not take with them when Thrawn forced them to retreat. Esva was determined to kill Grand Admiral Thrawn, presenting himself with determination and bitter melancholy moments before his demise.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|It was Sorro, dressed in Nuso Esva's mask and clothing.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
While posing as Odo, Nuso Esva wore a metallic mask, a burgundy hooded [[Robe/Legends|robe]], black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> Before fleeing to the Quesoth homeworld,<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Esva commanded three fleets as powerful as the Eastern Fleet.<ref name="Choices of One" /> During the battle on Quethold, Esva carried a [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]] that contained a weapon, which he used to kill the Queen of the Red. He pointed that weapon at Trevik when he tasked the bowlcarrier with taking a message to Thrawn. Esva spoke his [[Nuso Esva's language|language]] into a communications device during the attack on the Red City.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Even if it was, Nuso Esva could put it back together. He's a military genius.|Vestin Axlon, to the Hand of Judgment|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
Rebel General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] feared Esva because the warlord could replace the Empire with an empire of his own. Axlon considered Esva a military genius. Pellaeon believed that Esva was a competent member of the Imperial Court while the warlord operated under the pseudonym of Lord Odo. Esva spoke the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> in addition to his own. Esva did not understand the Quesoth Soldier Speak language.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|*very*perceptive comment. In fact, if you shift each of the consonent ''[sic]'' of Nusoesva's ''[sic]'' name back one consonent ''[sic]'', and shift each vowel one back (and treat "y" as a vowel) &hellip;|Timothy Zahn|<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=posts/10150348265048713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2011-09-28|quote=@Xavi: *very*perceptive comment. In fact, if you shift each of the consonents of Nusoesva's ''[sic]'' name back one consonent, ''[sic]'' and shift each vowel one back (and treat "y" as a vowel) &hellip;|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/1i8t}}</ref>}}
[[File:ChoicesOfOne-PreliminaryFrontCover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Nuso Esva debuted in ''Choices of One''.]]
Warlord Nuso Esva first appeared in ''[[Choices of One]]'', a novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> and published on [[July 19]], [[2011]]. He was first mentioned in an [https://web.archive.org/web/20110610064424/https://www.starwars.com/vault/books/choices_of_one_excerpt/index.html excerpt] of ''Choices of One'' published in the same year's [[June 7]].<ref name="Excerpt">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/choices_of_one_excerpt/index.html|text=''Choices of One'' Excerpt}}</ref>

During a [[September 28]], 2011, [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook chat]], the [[Wikipedia:Author|author]] confirmed that Esva's name was a coded version of [[Wikipedia:Professor Moriarty|Moriarty]],<ref name="Facebook" /> a character from [[Wikipedia:Arthur Conan Doyle|Arthur Conan Doyle's]] [[Wikipedia:Sherlock Holmes|''Sherlock Holmes'']] stories.<ref name="TFP">{{BookCite|container=[[Wikipedia:The Final Problem|The Adventure of the Final Problem]]|author=[[Wikipedia:Arthur Conan Doyle|Doyle, Arthur Conan]]|title=[[Wikipedia:The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes|The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes]]|publisher=[[Wikipedia:George Newnes Ltd|George Newnes]]|date=1894}}</ref> If each consonant of "Nuso Esva" is replaced with the [[Wikipedia:Consonant|consonant]] before it in the [[Wikipedia:Latin alphabet|Latin alphabet]] and each [[Wikipedia:Vowel|vowel]] is replaced with the preceding vowel in the Latin alphabet, counting y, "Nuso Esva" becomes "Moriarty."<ref name="Facebook" />

In a [[February 27]], [[2022]] interview with the Fandom Spotlite site, Zahn stated that ''Choices of One'' and ''Crisis of Faith'' would not fit into the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] and that Esva was "adequately defeated" when asked if he had planned to write more stories about him.<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=un3lpw8x9tk|text=Timothy Zahn On THRAWN & ELI VANTO - Farpoint 2022 Interview|channel=@FandomSpotlite|name=Fandom Spotlite|date=2022-02-27}}</ref>
